post.description:
Log in with username and password; sets the session cookie.

Every failure gives the same 401 ``LOGIN_FAILED``.

Set the password with a setup or reset code, then log in.

If the login fails afterwards (a locked account or address), the password
is set nevertheless and the answer is the 401 of ``/login``.
End this session and delete the cookie.

get.description:
List documents showing metadata only, without proposal counts.

The status is the logged-in user's; a system admin or a lead of the
project may ask for another annotator's. Review mode is refused to a user
whose roles do not give it; in it each document says whether it has
proposals, so review navigation can skip documents there is nothing to
review in.

Raises:
    AccessDenied: ``MODE_NOT_ALLOWED`` (403) for review mode without it.

ActiveHoldView.title: ActiveHoldView
ActiveHoldView.description: An active pause on the owner's task; other people's reports stay unnamed.

ActorRef.title: ActorRef
ActorRef.description: Reference to human or tool actor.

Annotation.title: Annotation
Annotation.description: Annotation entity referencing ontology term, layer, type, context axes and evidence.

AnnotationRef.title: AnnotationRef
AnnotationRef.description: Reference binding annotation ID and immutable version hash.

AnnotationSnapshot.title: AnnotationSnapshot
AnnotationSnapshot.description: Immutable snapshot binding annotation, evidence, text, layer config and ontology digests (V3).

AnnotationTypeDefinition.title: AnnotationTypeDefinition
AnnotationTypeDefinition.description: Definition of an annotation type available in a layer.

AxisDefinition.title: AxisDefinition
AxisDefinition.description: Definition of an individual annotation contextual axis.

CurrentUser.title: CurrentUser
CurrentUser.description: The logged-in user, as the editor shows it (index Q10).

DecisionBarView.title: DecisionBarView
DecisionBarView.description: Rows per category; hyphenated categories map to underscore fields.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Immutable document containing original text and UTF-8 byte SHA-256.

DocumentLinkQuery.title: DocumentLinkQuery
DocumentLinkQuery.description:
Documents filters of one Progress count (follow-up spec FD11).

``GET document-rows`` with these filters (lists as repeated parameters)
lists exactly the counted rows: the count equals its ``bar.shown``.

DocumentRowFilters.title: DocumentRowFilters
DocumentRowFilters.description:
The Documents filters, same names and values as its query parameters.

``step``, ``stage`` and ``plan`` take one value or a list (OR within one
filter, AND across filters). Filters never change batch targets, their
order, ``steps``, ``common`` or ``skipped``; they drive ``not_shown``.

Draft.title: Draft
Draft.description: Mutable, revisioned working state of a workspace.

EditorProposal.title: EditorProposal
EditorProposal.description: Editor projection; producer metadata never changes snapshot hashes.

EvidenceMention.title: EvidenceMention
EvidenceMention.description: Evidence mention spanning one or more ordered, non-overlapping segments.

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: Reference binding evidence ID and specific immutable version hash.

EvidenceSnapshot.title: EvidenceSnapshot
EvidenceSnapshot.description: Immutable snapshot of evidence bound to text and document.

ImportAcceptance.title: ImportAcceptance
ImportAcceptance.description: Translations of these languages were reviewed outside Ontocurator.

ImportedProposals.title: ImportedProposals
ImportedProposals.description:
The proposals of one unit.

``notes`` maps every annotation id to its T1 provenance notes; they are not
part of the snapshot. ``defaulted_axes`` counts the axis values that arrived
with ``basis: defaulted``; they stay defaulted (``Annotation.axes_defaulted``).

IndexConfiguration.title: IndexConfiguration
IndexConfiguration.description: Declared defaults and application algorithms, separate from the runtime.

LayerDefinition.title: LayerDefinition
LayerDefinition.description: Definition of an annotation layer binding an ontology and types.

Member.title: Member
Member.description:
For non-lead callers ``username`` and ``display_name`` of other people
are empty (pseudonym only, D1); the caller's own record is complete.

MultilingualSearchPreferences.title: MultilingualSearchPreferences
MultilingualSearchPreferences.description: Personal defaults; temporary editor switches never change these.

MutationEnvelope.title: MutationEnvelope
MutationEnvelope.description: Request envelope identifying a write attempt across retries.

OntologyDefinition.title: OntologyDefinition
OntologyDefinition.description: Definition of an ontology artifact bound to a task profile.

OntologyTranslation.title: OntologyTranslation
OntologyTranslation.description: One language an ontology can be searched in besides English.

OpenTasksView.title: OpenTasksView
OpenTasksView.description:
Open tasks of a member per task: non-revoked and unsubmitted or paused
(``open_task_counts``, the count of the batch dialog's people).

OpenWorkspaceRequest.title: OpenWorkspaceRequest
OpenWorkspaceRequest.description: Request payload for opening a workspace draft.

OpenWorkspaceResponse.title: OpenWorkspaceResponse
OpenWorkspaceResponse.description: Response returned upon opening a workspace.

PersonRefView.title: PersonRefView
PersonRefView.description: ``display_name`` only for lead callers or the caller's own record.

PlanChoice.title: PlanChoice
PlanChoice.description: Plan flags chosen in the upload's "Work plan" step.

PlanRowsSet.title: PlanRowsSet
PlanRowsSet.description:
Exact flags per row (bulk Undo). ``undo`` restores ``restored_revision``,
never creates PLAN_RESTORED and needs ``confirm`` only when it withdraws
tasks assigned after the change (D22).

PreferencesUpdate.title: PreferencesUpdate
PreferencesUpdate.description: Partial update: omitted fields are kept, modes are merged per package.

ProgressStageView.title: ProgressStageView
ProgressStageView.description:
One stage card: rows in ``scope`` (Review or Annotate on), ``done`` of
``total`` and row counts per state (keys per card, see the spec), each
with the Documents query that lists its rows (``links``, same keys).

ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary
ProjectSummary.description: A project on the dashboard, with what the user may do in it.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Origin and extraction details for an annotation or statement.

ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision
ReviewDecision.description: Review decision record for a targeted annotation snapshot.

ReviewInputsRequest.title: ReviewInputsRequest
ReviewInputsRequest.description: Request payload for fetching targeted review inputs.

ReviewTargetSet.title: ReviewTargetSet
ReviewTargetSet.description: Immutable, sorted set of targeted annotation references for a review round.

RuleViolation.title: RuleViolation
RuleViolation.description: A project restriction violated by one annotation's immutable content.

SearchCandidate.title: SearchCandidate
SearchCandidate.description: Single candidate term returned by an ontology search route.

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description: Search request scoped to a workspace mention/annotation.

SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description: Result of an HPO search query including deterministic provenance.

SelectionSummary.title: SelectionSummary
SelectionSummary.description:
Assignable steps of the selected cases (D21).

``steps``: per (task, language) the versions and cases whose row has that
task's assign step, most versions first (then most cases, then task and
language). ``common`` is the first of ``steps`` (None when nothing is
assignable), the step the dialog preselects; ``skipped`` counts the
selected cases that ``common`` does not reach, by skip reason.
``not_shown`` counts selected cases the current filters hide; filters
never change ``steps``, ``common`` or ``skipped``.

StepDetailView.title: StepDetailView
StepDetailView.description: Secondary line of a next step (spec "Next step").

TaskProfile.title: TaskProfile
TaskProfile.description: Complete specification of task profile, ontologies, layers, and types.

TaskScope.title: TaskScope
TaskScope.description: Execution scope defining active editable and reference layers for a workspace.

TermLabel.title: TermLabel
TermLabel.description:
Display data for a term, resolved against the layer's pinned ontology.

``primary_term_id`` differs from ``term_id`` when the requested id is an
alternative (merged) id or differs in case. For obsolete terms,
``replaced_by`` names the designated successor and ``consider`` lists
looser suggestions, so the UI can offer a replacement.

TranslationCheck.title: TranslationCheck
TranslationCheck.description: One automatic check of a translation run.

TreeLevel.title: TreeLevel
TreeLevel.description: An expanded node and the children shown under it.

TreeNodeRequest.title: TreeNodeRequest
TreeNodeRequest.description: Ask about a node the walk has already shown.

TreeOpenRequest.title: TreeOpenRequest
TreeOpenRequest.description: Start a walk at the term of an annotation.

TreeOpenResponse.title: TreeOpenResponse
TreeOpenResponse.description: The tree as it opens: roots, the expanded path to the start term.

TreeTermDetail.title: TreeTermDetail
TreeTermDetail.description: What the detail pane shows for the selected node.

UploadPlanLanguage.title: UploadPlanLanguage
UploadPlanLanguage.description: One row of the upload's "Work plan" step: the sources or one language.

VersionAcceptanceView.title: VersionAcceptanceView
VersionAcceptanceView.description: Newest acceptance record of a translation version (lead workflow).

VersionDiscardView.title: VersionDiscardView
VersionDiscardView.description: Discard record of a text version (lead workflow).

WorkspaceKey.title: WorkspaceKey
WorkspaceKey.description: Identifier for an isolated local workspace.

WorkspaceView.title: WorkspaceView
WorkspaceView.description: Loaded view of a workspace including document, draft and submissions.
